allow: Bash(PGPASSWORD=postgres psql -h localhost -U postgres -d weibo -c "SHOW max_connections;")
Bash(PGPASSWORD=postgres psql -h localhost -U postgres -d weibo -c "SELECT count\(*\) as active_connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'weibo';")

Bash(PGPASSWORD=postgres psql -h localhost -U postgres -d weibo -c "SELECT pid, usename, application_name, state, query_start, state_change FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'weibo' ORDER BY state_change DESC LIMIT 20;")

Bash(psql -U postgres -h localhost -c "SELECT max_connections, current_setting\(''max_connections''\) as current, count\(*\) as active FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY max_connections, current_setting\(''max_connections''\);")
